## v1.10.0 — Storylines, status bar & structure layout, preset files with a Tavern Helper installer

### Storylines
- End an input with `#name` to write a side story; names starting with `if` are if-lines (another possibility that doesn't affect the other storylines). Presets opt in with `storylines` in the manifest; users can switch the feature off on the Config page.
- The history is arranged per storyline: other storylines first, the current one last, each group introduced by a separator system message. Worldbook and other depth injections keep their position relative to the main storyline. If-lines are invisible to other storylines by default.
- More tags: `#` returns to the most recent side storyline; `#?` / `#!?` / `#if?` start a new side storyline / main storyline / if-line that the AI names (new structure kind `storyline`); `#!name` makes a storyline the main one (applied when the reply arrives, with the AI naming an unnamed previous main storyline); `#@…` makes a storyline invisible to the others. No space is needed before `#`, except after ASCII letters / digits (so `C#` stays text).
- Tags stay in the message (visible when editing), are hidden in the chat and stripped before sending. Replies remember their storyline per swipe.
- **Storylines** tab: every storyline with its floors (jump to them), if-line and visibility switches, rename, make main. Messages on other storylines get a small badge.
- **Variable freeze**: MVU and Tavern Helper variable updates are blocked on side storylines (`all`, the default / `if` only / `off`), through MVU's events and ST's chat data only. Presets can tell the model with `storyline.frozen`.
- Background side storylines are sent as their synopses only; each storyline has its own cache-optimization state; structures (`::last`), chat memory and recap read the chat in storyline order.
- Conditions `storyline.name / main / if / new / grouped / naming / namingMain / switching / frozen`, macros `{{ap::storyline}}` / `{{ap::storyline::main}}`, `ap preview --storyline …`. Option cards and impersonated replies on a side storyline carry its tag.

### Structure layout, status bar and custom cards
- Stages and structures share one ordering axis: stage `order`; structure `order` as a number or `before:` / `after:` a stage (`@content` is the story); per-workflow `structures.order`. Think → status → story → synopsis is now one declaration.
- `tools.orderPrefix` (`true` = `{{n}}_`) prefixes every stage and structure field of the turn with its zero-padded position, so models and relays that write JSON keys alphabetically still follow the workflow order. Replaces `structurePrefix` when set.
- New structure kind **`status`** (date / DayN, weekday, time, location, weather…), generated before the story and shown as an editable card above the message, with weather icons; `{{ap::structure::status::last}}` keeps it continuous.
- Message cards live in a `top` or `bottom` area with sort keys; structures can place themselves among the built-in cards with `ui.position` / `ui.order`.
- **Custom structure components**: `ui.template` (EJS) or `ui.module` (ES module exporting `mount(root, ctx)`) plus `ui.style`, rendered in a shadow root. Installing a preset with components asks to *Trust and enable* (declining doesn't block the install); changed code asks again. Config → Custom UI.

### Structure history
- Any non-inline structure can declare `history: { depth, template, position, when }`: the last N assistant messages carry their values back into the history — filled into a template with field placeholders, before / after the story or at a sort key, under a condition. Cache optimization's sticky rendering covers it.
- New condition `last.<id>` (a custom / status structure already has an earlier value in the chat).
- The legacy synopsis `history` / `historyTemplate` form keeps producing exactly the same output.

### Preset resources from SillyTavern and Tavern Helper
- **Regex scripts** (`regex-scripts/`, ST's own fields, ST exports accepted) become ST preset-scoped regex scripts of the Carrier, with stable ids.
- **Quick Reply sets** (`quick-replies/`) are written into ST's Quick Reply extension while the preset is active — translated, `{{ap::name}}` expanded; global sets are added to the global list and removed with other presets; your own sets with the same name are never overwritten. Presets with quick replies that run without a click ask for trust on install.
- **Tavern Helper scripts** (`tavern-helper-scripts/`) are written into the Carrier's `extensions.tavern_helper`; Tavern Helper asks to enable them as usual. Rebuilds keep switches, script data, variables and your own scripts; AP offers a reload when the scripts of the Carrier in use change. AP never calls Tavern Helper's code.

### Preset files and the Tavern Helper installer
- `ap build` now writes a **preset file**: a standard ST Chat Completion preset that carries the AP artifact in `extensions.advanced_preset_file`. The file name is unchanged.
- Without AP, the file imports as a normal ST preset; a notice asks the model to explain how to install AP. With Tavern Helper, an optional installer script installs, updates or enables AP, trying GitHub → GitLab → Codeberg, and explains a manual install if all fail.
- Once AP runs, preset files already in ST's list are taken over: installed (trust is asked; never a downgrade) and replaced by the Carrier, selected if the file was. The notice never reaches the model and the installer never stays in a Carrier.
- Panel export (and ST's export button on a Carrier) writes a preset file; *Include the Advanced Preset installer* is ticked by default. CLI: `build.installer` in the manifest, `--installer` / `--no-installer`. `ap dev` still serves the bare artifact.

### Fixes
- Switching AP's branch in ST's Extensions panel now reloads the extension.
- `ap dev`: the dev artifact is loaded before the startup Carrier sync, so the dev Carrier is no longer rebuilt twice on every load.
- With seven panel tabs, labels are hidden below 420px instead of overlapping; tags and badges follow the storylines switch.
- The status card's edit pencil is pinned top-right like the synopsis card's.

### Other
- CI mirrors `main` and `dev` to GitLab and Codeberg (the installer's fallbacks).
- Docs and bundled Agent Skills updated (new reference pages: preset files, regex & quick replies, Tavern Helper scripts).
- **Built-in Petals 7.10.0.**

Artifact format is unchanged (3). Older AP versions ignore stage / structure `order`, `ui`, the `status` kind, structure `history` objects, `storylines`, regex scripts, quick replies and Tavern Helper scripts, and AP ≤ 1.9 can't read preset files — presets using them should set `minAdvancedPreset: 1.10.0` (`ap check` warns). Building them needs CLI 1.10.0.

npm: [`advanced-preset@1.10.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/advanced-preset/v/1.10.0)
